title: CPWN Pack 2
description: The latest modpack for the CPWN server community, by Planet One.
body:
The **CPWN Pack 2** is the long-anticipated sequel to our original [CPWN Pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cpwn), which was built for the [combined Planet One and Club Penguin Wiki Network Community Server.](https://modrinth.com/server/planet-one).

**If you want to play on our server, this is the modpack to download!**

Major mods from the original CPWN Pack such as:

- Create
- Biomes O' Plenty
- Alex's Caves
- Chipped
- Farmer's Delight

have been updated to their 1.21.1 versions, meaning that builds on the server have stayed mostly intact. To make things interesting, we've also added some new mods to bring a bit of variety such as:

- Ars Nouveau
- BetterEnd
- Totemic
- Create: Aeronautics

This is now the required modpack for the [CPWN Server](https://modrinth.com/server/planet-one) - I highly recommend using the Modrinth app to play to keep everything up to date!

6GB of allocated RAM is recommended for this modpack, however if you don't play with shaders you might be able to get away with less.
